posts.title: News delivered without a game rebuild
posts.summary: This panel fetched a separate JSON file. Edit this post, click Load content, and the page updates. These are demonstration posts, not release announcements.

posts.title: A page that stays useful while loading
posts.summary: Try Slow load to see the loading state. A failed refresh keeps the last successfully loaded posts visible.

posts.summary: Switch to HTML page to fetch a styled document into the same panel. Its scripts and navigation stay disabled.
